title: Participation semantic wave
interpreter: running GPT-6 Codex agent; not GPT-5.6 Terra
physical_work_performed: Directly read cited evidence and performed the case analyses below; code only persists and hashes agent-authored results.

findings.claim: The Smith Family reports 5,478 people filling 5,983 national volunteer roles; a person can occupy multiple roles. Its 91% staff-support satisfaction has no respondent denominator on this page.
Plan reports five active office volunteers contributing 933 hours across three departments in FY24. The volunteer contact route is a report-period invitation, not verified current availability.
Red Cross reports about 35 participants from 14 countries at the Pacific IHL forum; this is a separate event from its 30-person course and eight-team moot.
Bush Heritage reports more than 47,235 volunteer hours in 2025-26; 98% placement satisfaction and 93% supported safety are survey claims with no sample size on the page.

ACFID describes member-led communities of practice led by volunteer convenors and interacting through MyACFID. A convenor's employer is an affiliation, not evidence that all that employer's staff participate.
ACFID reports 494 delegates from 179 organisations and 22 countries at its hybrid 2023 conference; counts of delegates, organisations and countries must not be combined.
Learning for Life supported 71,818 students; broader programs and activities involved 186,499 children/young people. These are nested/different populations without an explicit disjointness guarantee.
Caritas says its partner GAP runs participant-led Grassroots Youth Engagement for disengaged young Aboriginal people roughly 12–25, supported by local collaborations.
On PAR pairs kindergarten-to-Year-5 students and families with a team member for up to two years, in two communities; the pilot has helped 345 students.
A photo caption identifies First Nations young people participating in Young Mob on an Uluru cultural exchange; it establishes an activity example, not total participation or recruitment eligibility.

defects: D06: People, role, hour and reach units are not interchangeable.
D06b: Survey denominators and current volunteering availability are absent.
counterexamples: A caption is real participation evidence with very narrow scope.
remaining_limitations: Requested Terra interpreter unavailable after session model switch; no second model/API invoked.
10 represented pages read; one is caption/acknowledgment-led rather than participation-heavy.
persistence: create-exclusive staging file, flushed, Windows no-overwrite atomic rename
